mentions.name: TimeCap
mentions.description: This app removes the addictive sections of social media platforms, letting users check friends' updates (e.g., Instagram) without being distracted by content like reels. It is fully customizable, works on any social media app, and helped reduce the author's screen time to under an hour. It is free for one platform and costs $29.99/yr for unlimited platforms.
mentions.problem: Social media platforms' addictive sections distract users and inflate screen time.
mentions.audience: People who want to check friends' social media updates without getting distracted by addictive content like reels.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building TimeCap: an app that removes the addictive sections of any social media. That means that you can check your friends' updates on Instagram without getting distracted by reels.
